import numpy as np, os, re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()
for i in [1,2,3]:
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} input']); O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} output'])
    cnt=Counter(int(x) for r in I for x in r); bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    linec=max((c for c,n in cnt.items() if c!=bgc), key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    mark=min((c for c in cnt if c not in (bgc,linec)), key=lambda c:cnt[c])
    cy,cx=I.shape
    v=[c for c in range(cx) if all(I[r,c]==linec for r in range(cy))]
    h=[r for r in range(cy) if all(I[r,c]==linec for c in range(cx))]
    vc,v_=v[0],h[0]
    ys,xs=np.where(I==mark)
    results=[]
    Ss={
      'id': {(r,c) for r,c in zip(ys,xs)},
      'V-mir': {(r,2*vc-c) for r,c in zip(ys,xs)},
      'H-mir': {(2*h_-r,c) for r,c in zip(ys,xs)},
      'rot180': {(2*h_-r,2*vc-c) for r,c in zip(ys,xs)},
    }

        for rr,cc in S:
            if 0<=rr<O.shape[0] and 0<=cc<O.shape[1]: pred[rr,cc]=linec
        results.append((name,np.array_equal(pred,(O==linec))))

import numpy as np, os, re
from collections import Counter
def load():
    d=os.path.normpath(os.environ['RLM_SESSION_DIR'])
    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}
    for m in re.finditer(r'(Demo pair \d+ (?:input|output)|Test input) \((\d+)x(\d+)\):\n',t):
        k,h,w=m[1],int(m[2]),int(m[3])
        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]
    return G
G=load()

def analyze(i,anchor=None):
    I=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} input']);O=np.array(G[f'Demo pair {i} output'])
    cy,cx=I.shape
    cnt=Counter(I.flatten()); bgc=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    linec=max(((c,n) for c,n in cnt.items() if c!=bgc),key=lambda x:x[1])[0]
    mark=min(((c,n) for c,n in cnt.items() if c not in (bgc,linec)),key=lambda x:n)[0]
    ys,xs=np.where(I==mark)
    vr=[r for r in range(cy) if sum(I[r]==linec)==cx]; vc=[c for c in range(cx) if sum(I[:,c]==linec)==cy]
    vr,v_0=vrs:=vr[0],vcs:=vc[0] if vr and vc else None
    out=G[f'Demo pair {i} output']; ty,outg=np.array(out)
    print(f'pair{i}: in={I.shape} out={outg.shape} bg={bgc} line={linec} mark={mark} vr={vr} vc={vc}')
    return dict(I=I,O=O,bgc=bgc,linec=linec,mark=mark,ys=ys,xs=xs,vr=vr,vc=vc,out=ty)

for i in [1,2,3,4,5]:
    d=analyze(i)
    print(f'--- pair {i}: markers=',sorted(zip(d['ys'],d['xs'])))

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]

def solve(I):
    cnt=Counter(I.flatten()); bgc=max(cnt,key=lambda c:cnt[c]); nl={c:n for c,n in cnt.items() if c!=bgc}
    linec=max(nl,key=lambda c:nl[c]); objc=min(nl,key=lambda c:nl[c])
    H,W=len(I),len(I[0])
    rs=[sum(c==linec for c in r) for r in I]; cs=[sum(I[r][c]==linec for r in range(H)) for c in range(W)]
    mr=rs.index(max(rs)); mc=cs.index(max(cs))
    S={(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W) if I[r,c]==objc}
    Ts=[lambda r0,c0:(r0,c0),lambda r0,c0:(2*mr-r0,c0),lambda r0,c0:(r0,2*mc-c0),lambda r0,c0:(2*mr-r0,2*mc-c0)]
    res=np.full((H,W),bgc,dtype=int)
    for T in Ts:
        for r,c in S:
            rr,cc=T(r,c)
            if 0<=rr<H and 0<=cc<W: res[rr,cc]=linec
